extracted.intended_audience: writers submitting flash/concise literary nonfiction to Brevity magazine
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting extremely brief (flash) literary nonfiction essays to Brevity, including allowed length, formatting preferences, submission method, and policies (payment, AI policy).

rubrics_metrics.name: Target genre / form
rubrics_metrics.description: Brevity publishes ... writers working in the extremely brief (750 words or fewer) essay form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brevity: A Journal of Concise Literary Nonfiction — submissions should be concise literary nonfiction (flash essays).

rubrics_metrics.name: Length limit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works must conform to the 'extremely brief' length requirement; pieces longer than 750 words are not appropriate for the magazine's stated form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting preferences
rubrics_metrics.description: We prefer that submissions should be formatted as seen here (single space, no indentation, one extra space between paragraphs)...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternate formatting is acceptable only if it is a specific design element of the essay; otherwise follow single-spacing, no paragraph indentation, and one extra space between paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI-generated work policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Brevity does not accept submissions of AI-generated work, which includes writing that was partially created with or assisted by LLM technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an AI submission is identified, it will be rejected. The editors reserve the right to withdraw acceptances from any work found to be AI-generated, even after publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method / portal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are handled through the magazine's Submittable portal (follow the portal link/requirements on the site).

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment / honorarium
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are paid a $45 honorarium for featured essays (via PayPal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Payment is provided for featured essays and is made via PayPal; this is the stated compensation policy for accepted pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Art submissions (separate guidelines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Brevity magazine is seeking photographers and visual artists to illustrate future issues. For art submissions info, see our 'Call for Artists' page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visual art/photography submissions are accepted but governed by a separate Call for Artists page — follow that page for specifications and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Craft essay / blog submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Craft Essay section is now merged with the Brevity Blog. For submissions info, see below / the Brevity Blog.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are submitting craft essays (instructional/essay about craft), consult the Brevity Blog guidelines for the merged Craft Essay section rather than the main magazine flash-essay guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Openness to previously unpublished authors
rubrics_metrics.description: We have also featured many previously-unpublished authors, and take a special joy in helping to launch a new literary career.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The magazine actively considers previously-unpublished writers and is open to debut work, not only established authors.
